newsitem.title: ITALY: Suspect troop movements tax Italian investigators.
newsitem.headline: Suspect troop movements tax Italian investigators.

text.p: An Italian soldier claimed a removal allowance for transporting five tonnes of furniture in a tiny Fiat 500 car, a military prosecutor investigating fraudulent expense claims said on Wednesday.
Prosecutor Benedetto Roberti said the case was just one among a series of recent scams he was investigating involving 500 soldiers or officers of Italy's finance police force.
In another case, he said, an unspecified number of troops from a lancers' regiment claimed removal expenses for a non-existent transfer half the length of Italy.
Roberti said all the suspect claims, ranging from five million to 20 million lire ($3,300 to $13,200), had been submitted in 1995 or at the start of the year.
He said their existence showed publicity surrounding earlier inquiries into fraud in the navy and air force had not had a major deterrent effect.
"The magistrates do what they can but this immoral behaviour continues," Roberti said. He said more effective cost control in the armed forces would help stop the fraud.
